nora: Quick flag - onboarding vesta-62k-int3. Short smoke shows a deterministic kv-key jump at a rollover. Minimal repro below.

nora: repro (fast):
```bash
./run_smoke.sh --model vesta-62k-int3 --quant int3 --context 65536 --prompt fixtures/repeat_prefix_16k.txt --seed 3
```

nora: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-20 08:12:00] t=15870 emit="and" kv=15870 fp=0x4b2c phase=0x7ffa
[2026-03-20 08:12:01] t=16383 emit="the" kv=16383 fp=0x4fff phase=0x7fff
[2026-03-20 08:12:01] t=16384 emit="<GLITCH>" kv=16384 fp=0x8000 phase=0x8000  # abrupt phase/fingerprint change
```

devin: baseline fp16 run for vesta-62k-fp16 completes w/o issue. Deterministic on seed.

ash: can you run tools/rotary-trace --pos 16378:16390 --dump both-fp32,int3 ? want to compare exponent outputs across quant modes.

nora: ran trace, snippet: 
```
POS 16382 fp32_exp=0.00054321 int3_exp_q=0x12  (smooth)
POS 16383 fp32_exp=0.00055555 int3_exp_q=0x12  (smooth)
POS 16384 fp32_exp=0.00056789 int3_exp_q=0x80  (sudden step)
```

ash: that step in quantized exponent at the wrap point explains discontinuity. Two suspects: quant interp table entry for that bucket, or position->bucket mapping off-by-one at power boundary.

grep-bot: added label: ropecache/regression and linked INF-4820.

- vesta-62k-fp16 : ppl pre-roll 6.8 post-roll 6.9

devin: plan: 1) run bisect on quant-lut commits for rotary table, 2) add quick unit test tests/regressions/rotary_quant_step_mini.py that asserts no exponent-step at boundary, 3) add kv-fingerprint assertion to longctx smoke. I'll open a ticket and assign.
